attributes.name: Galvanic Kopis +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+2; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 2 to your check for each die rolled.

When playing another weapon, you may discard this card to add 1d4+2 and the Electricity trait to your combat check.
